claims.statement: For the explicit order-13 asymmetric ordinary tree and rank p=6 in the source report, the exact original-leaf selector is all eight leaves, S=-307, and the summed marked-neighborhood data satisfy E=kU+C and D+C-(2a+1-3p)Q=-kS=1535. In the stated finite random sample and exhaustive ordered-arm profile family, no eligible row has a proper nonempty favorable selector.
claims.scope: One explicitly encoded order-13 tree at p=6, plus the precisely bounded 5,000-tree seeded Prüfer sample and 342 ordered asymmetric arm profiles described in the source report and replayed by its copied program.
claims.reason: retained: independent direct subset enumeration confirms the exact tree, all original-leaf selector values, all eight tagged summands, the global arithmetic, and the auxiliary H_v rank domain. A replay of the copied producer program reproduces the two stated finite probe counts. These bounded facts establish no universal result and leave the primary claim open.

limitations: The fixture has S=-307 and therefore is not a counterexample to the primary inequality; all its original leaves are selected.
The finite random sample and ordered profile family do not exhaust ordinary trees or eligible ranks.
The budget identity is checked only on the fixture; no general across-tag inequality or selector propagation result is established.
All conclusions are bounded and proposed only.
